synth.notes:
Axis wall row block a + 3x3-block pieces on a 21x21 block grid (x=row); A1/A2 move selection up/down a block, A3/A4 left/right (pieces only), A5 cycles axis->pieces by bbox->axis.
Step 71 mechanic: the axis is not blocked by pieces; it slides under them (piece layer 4), so the reflection 2a-r is recomputed and target/wall re-occlusion follows.
Reflections skip piece-occupied blocks; render wall<target<reflection<piece (first solid wins, else topmost hole fill >=0), then re-extract: wall/player comps over own cells plus all 0 cells ranked by bbox, 0-only comps hidden; targets per sprite.
Global counter hypothesis was a red herring: counter never changes; outcomes follow from selection and geometry. Passes 30/30 stateless too.
Unconfirmed: whether pieces may enter the axis row or overlap blocked in other ways, ACTION6/7 (no-ops), piece cycle order past the first piece.
